# Vault Human

> Vault Human is daily coaching for the whole of you: one short key every morning, one small practice, and a real coach who walks the year with you. Online, anywhere in the United States.

## About
Vault Human, LLC was founded by Russ Michaels (legal name Russ Michael Schmidtberger) in Austin, Texas. The premise: a person's past, present and future are one connected life, and most help on offer treats them in pieces.

Contact: vault@vaulthuman.com · (888) 833-2510 · https://www.vaulthuman.com

## Plans
- Vault Keys membership - a key and a practice every morning plus a live monthly call. First week free, then $99 a month. Cancel any time.
- One-on-one coaching with Russ Michaels - three private 60-minute sessions a month, membership included. $999 a month.
- A free 30-minute call is available at https://www.vaulthuman.com/book/
